testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.text: Dr. Shrestha is incredibly gentle and patient. I was very anxious about my root canal, but she explained everything clearly and made it completely painless. Highly recommend SmileSure to anyone looking for quality dental care!

testimonials.name: Rajesh Kumar
testimonials.text: Best dental experience we've had as a family. The clinic is spotlessly clean, and the staff is very professional. My kids actually look forward to their dental visits now!

testimonials.name: Anita Verma
testimonials.text: I got my teeth whitening done here and the results are amazing! Dr. Shrestha took her time to explain the process and aftercare. The clinic has all modern equipment. Very satisfied!

testimonials.name: Amit Gupta
testimonials.text: Finally found a dentist I can trust! No unnecessary treatments, just honest advice. Dr. Shrestha is very knowledgeable and the consultation was thorough. The location is also very convenient.

testimonials.name: Meera Agarwal
testimonials.text: My 6-year-old daughter was scared of dentists, but Dr. Shrestha handled her so well. Patient, kind, and very good with children. The clinic environment is also very child-friendly.

testimonials.name: Vikram Singh
testimonials.text: Got my braces from SmileSure. Dr. Shrestha being an orthodontist really knows her work. Regular follow-ups are always on time, and my teeth are already looking much better after 6 months!
